Add createPatch: JSON Patch (RFC 6902) generation

createPatch(from, to) returns a JSON Patch that applyPatch turns from
into to. Objects are diffed member by member; arrays are aligned by
equal elements, so an added, removed or moved element is one or two
operations and the elements around it are not rewritten. Changed
scalars and type changes are replaced whole.
